description: This file is a type definitions source file for Node.js's 'events' module, defining types, classes, and interfaces related to event-driven architecture in Node.js. It provides typings for EventEmitter class, methods, options, and related constructs, facilitating type safety and auto-completion for TypeScript projects using Node.js events.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: Represents the core event-driven architecture component. Supports adding, removing, and emitting events, with advanced features such as once, prepend, raw listeners, and max listener configuration.

classes.name: EventEmitterAsyncResource
classes.description: An extension of EventEmitter with integrated AsyncResource tracking for better async context management.

methods.name: addAbortListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for the 'abort' event on an AbortSignal, ensuring safe resource cleanup and disposal.

methods.name: getEventListeners
methods.description: Retrieves all listeners associated with a specific event on an EventEmitter or EventTarget.

methods.name: getMaxListeners
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of listeners allowed on an EventEmitter or EventTarget.

methods.name: listenerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of listeners registered for a given event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Returns an async iterator for events emitted by an EventEmitter or EventTarget; supports optional abort signal.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Creates a promise that resolves with event arguments the next time the specified event is emitted.

methods.name: setMaxListeners
methods.description: Configures the maximum number of event listeners for one or more EventEmitters or EventTargets.
